_README.purpose: Phase-3 TRIGGERED talent effects. register-skills.js listens for combat events; when an owner of a listed talent meets the trigger, it (optionally prompts a cost, then) resolves a secondary effect. Keyed by exact talent name. Runtime-only: fetched at ready, copied into the module at build. These talents are PURE triggers — they are deliberately NOT in talent-rolls.json (no manual clickable), so they only fire automatically.

fields.on: Trigger event. v1 supports: 'deal-damage' (you rolled damage of a matching type, via the rollDamage wrapper), 'kill' (a creature dropped to 0 HP and you are the presumed killer, via the applyDamage hook), 'take-damage' (you took damage, via applyDamage).
fields.when: Filter object. damageType: string | array | 'any' (deal-damage only).
fields.cost: { resource: 'inv'|'foc'|'opportunity', value:N, optional:true }. optional:true → a Yes/No 'may spend' prompt; inv/foc are best-effort auto-deducted; opportunity is trusted (player pays).
fields.oncePerRound: true → fires at most once per combat round (tracked via flags.edha-content.trigRound[name] vs game.combat.round). Outside combat it is unrestricted.
fields.effect: { kind, formula, damageType, target, radius?, resourceGain? }. kind: 'damage' (target.applyDamage), 'damage-aoe' (each token within radius ft of the victim/target), 'heal' (capped HP restore), 'thp' (Edha Temp HP), 'affliction' (apply the 'afflicted' status + chat the ongoing amount). target: 'prompt' (your current targets, minus the primary victim), 'triggering'/'victim' (the creature that triggered it), 'near-victim' (AoE around the victim), 'self'. formula resolves against the OWNER's roll data ([Tier][Die] = '(@tier)d(2 * @skills.<color>.rank + 2)').

_README.limitations: v1 deliberately omits: hit-multiple (Flashpoint), conditional-vs-state (Severance vs Isolated, Crown of Thorns), resource-state gating (Knowledge Insight on-kill transfer), movement/positioning/ally-count (Momentum's Edge, Coordinated Hunt, Pack Pressure), periodic & HP-threshold (adversary Glyph Pulse, Stitchmother Phase 2). KILL attribution: applyDamage does not name the killer, so v1 treats the acting user's character / controlled token as the killer (GM adjudicates). Nested kills from a trigger's own AoE do NOT auto-chain (re-entrancy guard) — resolve secondary kills by hand.

Arc Flash.note: Red/Conflagration. After you deal energy damage, may spend 1 Investiture to arc half [Tier][Die] energy to a 2nd target within 10 ft. Target the secondary creature, then accept the prompt.

Afterburn.note: Red/Conflagration. After you deal energy damage, spend an Opportunity to leave the target Afflicted [half [Tier][Die] energy] ongoing. Opportunity is trusted (no auto-deduct). Target the creature, then accept the prompt.

Chain Detonation.note: Red/Conflagration. When a creature you kill drops in your fire, half [Tier][Die] energy to each creature within 5 ft of it. Nested kills don't auto-chain (resolve by hand).

Necrotic Cascade.note: Death (Morrath). When a creature drops to 0 HP, [Tier][Die] spirit to each enemy within 10 ft of it. Nested kills don't auto-chain.

Predator's Due.note: Black/Ritual. When you reduce a character to 0 HP, regain [Tier][Die] health and 1 Investiture. Fires on each kill (re-entrancy guard prevents loops).
